definitions.short: a figure (carved on stone, the wall, or any object); figuratively, imagination
definitions.full: H4906. maskith מַשְׂכִּית noun feminine show-piece, figure, imagination ; — absolute ׳מ Lev 26:1 , **on ancient rock-carvings in Canaan compare Ghosn-el-Howie JBL xxiii (1904), 211 ff. ; suffix מַשְׂכִּיתוֺ Ezek 8:12 , מַשְׂכִּתוֺ Prov 18:11 ; plural construct מַשְׂכִיּוֺת 25:11 ; Psa 73:7 , suffix מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָם Num 33:52 ; — 1 show-piece , specifically carved figure , of idolatrous symbols, Num 33:52 (P; || צַלְמֵי מַסֵּכֹתָם ), מ ׳אֶבֶן Lev 26:1 (|| מַצֵּבָה etc.), מ ׳חַדְרֵי Ezek 8:12 ( >strike out Co); elsewhere ׳מ כֶּסֶף Prov 25:11 silver carvings. 2 imagination, conceit , Prov 18:11 , ׳מ לֵבָב Psa 73:7 .

occurrences.englishText: “ ‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am Yahweh your God.
then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
The rich man’s wealth is his strong city,

Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘Yahweh doesn’t see us. Yahweh has forsaken the land.’ ”
